title: Half are small samples
text:
It's fun having a monthly product subscription. It's kinda like Christmas waiting to see what the next box will contain.
I just received my 3rd package and have found that it's just not a good value for me.
Approximately 1/3 of the products I will not use ( ie: due to color or skin type ), another 1/3 are similar to beauty products that I'm already using. Therefore I'm only enjoying around 35%.
I do have to say that I've received many really nice products.
Also, included are coupons for discounts on anything you may decide to purchase.
I think this would work out better for someone that has other family members that you could share select beauty products with.
label: neutral
